quest.title: The Final Treasure
quest.description: Miitoboru seems to have some request. Time to ask him about the details...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Miitoboru
dialogues.text: Ahoy, here you are. I thought you'd be too busy flying around the islands with those wings o' yours.

dialogues.speaker: Miitoboru
dialogues.text: Bet you've long forgotten your old mate Miitoboru, sitting there slowly soaking away in the ocean.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, you said you needed our help. What's up?

dialogues.speaker: Miitoboru
dialogues.text: It's not that important... Remember when you helped me find the missing pieces of my body?

dialogues.speaker: Miitoboru
dialogues.text: How can I put it... I'm not sure if it's because I've fulfilled my wishes, or if these waters are slowly diminishing my ability to talk...

dialogues.speaker: Miitoboru
dialogues.text: Recently, I find myself sleeping most of the time rather than staying conscious...

choices.text: Is it because the machine was turned off...

response.speaker: Miitoboru
response.text: #I see... So it's because of some contraption that I became your Waverider and could communicate with you, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... Does that mean that once the effects of the machine wear off, Miitoboru won't be able to talk anymore?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #We gotta do something before it's too late, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Miitoboru
response.text: Haha, there'll be no need for that, Paimon... I am quite content that I had the chance to talk to you at all.

response.speaker: Miitoboru
response.text: Argh... The more I think about it, for me, as a ship, to have gotten to talk to you in the past few days... It really is a wondrous thing, the stuff dreams are made of...

response.speaker: Miitoboru
response.text: But now, I need to ask you for one more favor...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Tell us.

response.speaker: Miitoboru
response.text: Remember when I told you that once we found my body, I'd take you for a cruise? Well, it seems my body was reduced to a slew of sorry shipwrecks...

response.speaker: Miitoboru
response.text: And most of the treasure was taken away, leaving nothing good for you...

response.speaker: Miitoboru
response.text: But this time, I swear as a mighty pirate ship, there be treasure ahoy, and a fine treasure at that! Or else may I be strangled by seagrass and fed to the fish! Just trust me one last time!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, {NICKNAME}, since Miitoboru probably won't be able to speak soon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #And... Since there really is treasure this time... Let's go, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Time to set sail!

response.speaker: Miitoboru
response.text: Argh! Come on then, me hearties! Time to come aboard!

choices.text: Is Miitoboru also affected by the machine...

talks.objective: Sail to where the treasure lies

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, that was close. Paimon was sure we were gonna sink!

dialogues.speaker: Kosekimaru
dialogues.text: #Haha, a talking ship is still just a ship. {NICKNAME}'s superb sailing skill was what saw us safely through the storm.

response.speaker: Kosekimaru
response.text: Haha, I'd rather not.

response.speaker: Kosekimaru
response.text: *sigh* I'm afraid I may have triggered the thunderstorm. These waters are less stable than they once were...

response.speaker: Kosekimaru
response.text: #But... we've arrived! {NICKNAME}, Paimon, the treasure is right up there!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Isn't this the place we first visited when we were looking for treasure? There was nothing here but half of Kosekimaru's hull!

response.speaker: Kosekimaru
response.text: I am certain that there's treasure up there this time. It's... What did I call it again? It's the intuition of a mighty pirate ship!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait a minute... You said you had two things to tell us, right? And the first one was that you'd remembered your name. What was the other one?

response.speaker: Kosekimaru
response.text: Hahaha, I thought you'd already forgotten. I'll tell you when you come back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We found the treasure. Look, it's a model pirate ship! Your intuition finally worked this time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, what's the other thing you wanted to tell us?

dialogues.speaker: Kosekimaru
dialogues.text: (The ship named Kosekimaru does not respond...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Hmph, but he said he'd tell us when we returned.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kosekimaru... you're a big fat liar!
